Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You feel the rune take the weight as though a mountain had leaned against the blow.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before taking physical damage.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

The rune takes the weight. For this damage event, gain physical resistance 3. Afterward, you may move 1 square without provoking. This does not add to existing resistance.
